name: How can I prevent my shower drain from clogging?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my shower drain from clogging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing shower drain clogs involves a few simple habits. Install a drain screen or hair catcher to prevent hair and soap scum from going down the drain. After each shower, rinse the drain with hot water for a minute or two to help flush away loose debris. Periodically, pour a mixture of baking soda followed by white vinegar into the drain, let it sit for 20-30 minutes, then flush with hot water. This can help break down minor buildups. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemicals down any drains, as this can exacerbate clogs or damage pipes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using a drain screen, rinsing with hot water, and performing periodic baking soda/vinegar flushes. Avoid harsh chemicals.
